chunk_map.heading: Your insight is the strategy: which customer, which bet, which no

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: L8 'Which of these will the three of you decide this week?' is the closest: 'these' resolves to the four 'Which...' choices on L6, same chunk; 'the three of you' is direct address to the room. L8 'That is real strategy work' resolves to the choosing named in L6. Harm (reader cannot resolve a pronoun) absent.

rules_evaluated.na_reason: no pointer to another file or slide by position

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Every backward reference points at a beat that exists.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no 'the X you did/saw' backward reference

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Live-demo beats survive a text read.

rules_evaluated.evidence: Single chunk carries three self-contained paragraphs (L4, L6, L8) with a claim of their own: 'The analysis does not choose.' (L4). Not a wait-state slide.

Header L1 'Your insight is the strategy: which customer, which bet, which no' vs body L6 'Which customer you serve first... Which bet gets the next slice. Which good idea you say no to' - all three named parts are delivered; outcome (L6) is extra, not contradicting.

Closest: L6 four-leg 'Which outcome... Which customer... Which bet... Which good idea' anaphora; each leg carries distinct concrete content (outcome, customer+waiting, bet+slice, no+half-built) so third-leg-new-content test passes. grep: no 'Not X. Not Y.' shape, no number+retraction, no verb triplet, no self-grading superlative ('real strategy work' L8 is not a superlative). Harm (empty cadence leg) absent.

rules_evaluated.evidence: grep of body (L1-9) for firing|compendium|forcing function|beat|mood|surface|writing surface -> 0. 'bet' (L6) is ordinary product vocabulary.
